topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I found remnants of another life nestled in the shadows of my attic. Old photographs, a child's toy, books with pages yellowed and crisp. Each object whispers of times past, of laughter and quiet moments, now_only echoes. I tried to sort through it all, but the air grew heavy, thick with memories not mine. The dust clung to my skin, the weight of forgotten things pressing down. I closed the door, sealing away the silence, the untouched remnants of a life that once thrived here. It's an odd sort of intrusion, stepping into someone's discarded past, where every box and drawer is a chapter I can never fully read.
